transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what made me come in is that... well, after work or class, I’ll sit down with my laptop and I just end up eating a lot. Like, a whole takeout meal, plus chips, sweets, and whatever other snacks are in my desk drawer. It's just way more than I ever planned to eat, and definitely more than I’d ever eat around anyone else.
When you are eating these large amounts of food, do you feel like you are unable to stop or that you cannot control how much you are eating?

Yeah, that's exactly what it is. Um, once I start, it feels like I’m almost watching myself keep reaching for the next thing. Even while I’m sitting there thinking... Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish and you’re not even enjoying this anymore. I just... I can't seem to actually make myself stop.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever try to compensate for the amount you consumed by doing things like vomiting, taking laxatives, fasting for long periods, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do any of those things. Um, I've never tried to make myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything like that. And I definitely don't exercise a ton or stop eating the next day. I usually just... I just feel really miserable and overly full afterwards, but I don't try to undo it.
